dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/10] Next,a clinical interview,based on the DSM-III-R criteria [4], was administered by an independent psychologist. The objective of the study was to focus on children with a sub-threshold depressive profile.A cut-off score was chosen according to Kovacs [37]. Therefore, the study included children showing depressive symptoms on a screening questionnaire and/or a Tscore on a parent measure above a cut-off, and at least one criterion of a Major Depressive Disorder, but without other apparent axis-I problems.
